hook.text: Reindeer on St. Matthew Island grew from 29 to 6,000 in 20 years.

buildup.text: Carrying capacity is the maximum population a system can sustain.

discovery.text: The concept applies beyond biology. Servers have capacity. Teams have capacity. Markets have capacity.

twist.text: Carrying capacity is not fixed. Innovation can raise it. Drought can lower it. But at any given moment.

climax.text: Know your system's limit. Grow within it or invest in raising it. Ignoring capacity is the fastest path to a crash.

punchline.text: Every system has a limit. Respect it or face a crash.

quiz.question: What happened to the reindeer on St. Matthew Island?
options: They exceeded carrying capacity, depleted resources, and the population crashed
